using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.OpenAI;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Embeddings;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Http;
using OpenAI;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The OpenAI text embedding generation service.
    /// </summary>
    public class OpenAITextEmbeddingGenerationService : ITextEmbeddingGenerationService
    {
        private readonly string _modelId;
        private readonly OpenAIClient _openAIClient;
        private readonly ILoggerFactory _loggerFactory;
        private readonly int? _dimensions;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="OpenAITextEmbeddingGenerationService"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="modelId">The OpenAI model id.</param>
        /// <param name="openAIClient">The OpenAI client.</param>
        /// <param name="loggerFactory">The logger factory.</param>
        /// <param name="dimensions">The number of dimensions the resulting output embeddings should have.</param>
        public OpenAITextEmbeddingGenerationService(
            string modelId,
            OpenAIClient openAIClient,
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            int? dimensions)
        {
            _modelId = modelId;
            _openAIClient = openAIClient;
            _loggerFactory = loggerFactory;
            _dimensions = dimensions;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generates text embeddings for the given input text.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="inputText">The input text.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>A task that represents the asynchronous operation.</returns>
        public async Task<TextEmbedding> GenerateTextEmbeddingAsync(string inputText, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Implementation details...
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.VisualStudio.TestTools.UnitTesting;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.OpenAI;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Embeddings;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Http;
using OpenAI;

namespace TestOpenAIServiceCollectionExtensions
{
    [TestClass]
    public class OpenAIServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [TestMethod]
        public async Task AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration_ServiceProviderGetService_ReturnsLoggerFactory()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(p => p.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddSingleton<IServiceProvider>(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = OpenAIServiceCollectionExtensions.AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration(services, "modelId", null, null, null);

            // Assert
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(p => p.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.Once);
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public async Task AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration_ServiceProviderGetService_ThrowsException_WhenLoggerFactoryIsNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(p => p.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(null);

            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddSingleton<IServiceProvider>(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Act and Assert
            await Assert.ThrowsExceptionAsync<NullReferenceException>(() => OpenAIServiceCollectionExtensions.AddOpenAITextEmbeddingGeneration(services, "modelId", null, null, null));
        }
    }
}
